Faq.title: Good to know
Faq.q1: Can a mentor guarantee my admission or visa?
Faq.a1: No. Mentors share their own experience and point you to official sources. No one on this platform can promise an admission or a visa.
Faq.q2: What if the mentor doesn't show up?
Faq.a2: Your payment is held in escrow through Safepay. If a mentor misses the call, you can reschedule immediately or claim a 100% refund.
Faq.q3: Why can't I share my phone number in chat?
Faq.a3: Keeping communication on-platform protects your privacy, avoids scams, and keeps your booking protected by our escrow policy.
Faq.a4: Yes, applicants of all ages can join. If you are under 18, we ask that a parent or guardian reviews bookings and handles payments.

Footer.disclaimer: Study Abroad Mentor connects Pakistani students with verified peers studying abroad for informational guidance. Mentors do not provide certified immigration or legal advice, and our platform never guarantees admission or visa approval.
